newsitem.title: UK: UK bookmakers shorten odds on March 20 election.
newsitem.headline: UK bookmakers shorten odds on March 20 election.

text.p: Bookmakers Ladbrokes said on Wednesday they had cut the odds on a March 20 British election to evens from 5-4.
May 1 remains favourite at 4-6. April 10 is priced at 5-1, out from 4-1.
Labour remains 1-6 favourite to win most seats at the election, which must be held by May 22. The Conservatives are 7-2.
A Ladbrokes spokesman said May remains the government's choice for an election and Ladbrokes believes it represents the ruling Conservatives' best chance of victory.
